seo.title: Half price holidays in Asia | Happy Hop Holidays
seo.description: Half price on every package to Bali, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand. Book by 31 December 2026 for travel before June 2027.

hero.headline: Half price on your next holiday in Asia
hero.subhead: Bali, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, planned end to end by a local team.

image.alt: Kangaroo with a suitcase, holding a phone showing a booking confirmed tick

form.heading: Get your free quote
form.intro: Tell us a little about your trip and a member of our team will reply with options and rates.

highlights.title: Half price, clearly shown
highlights.text: Every destination shows the original price and the half-price offer side by side.

highlights.title: Hop Credit still counts
highlights.text: If a friend referred you, your Hop Credit can be used together with the half-price offer.

highlights.title: The essentials are included
highlights.text: A 4-star stay (other levels on request), private airport transfers and activities with tickets and transport.

highlights.title: A real person plans your trip
highlights.text: Share a few details and our team replies personally with options and rates.

destinations_heading: Where would you like to go?
destinations_lead: Prices shown are per person and already include the half-price offer.

steps.title: Tell us your plans
steps.text: Share your destination, rough dates and how many people are travelling.

steps.title: Get your written quote
steps.text: We reply with options and the price for your hotels and dates. Website prices are estimates until you have your quote.

steps.title: Secure it with a deposit
steps.text: A deposit secures your booking. Flights, visa and insurance are extra.

closing.heading: Half price ends 31 December 2026
closing.text: Book by then for travel before June 2027.
